params.description: {{sbc|Innate - Awakened Spirit:}} '''Udyr''' has no {{tip|ability|ultimate ability}} and instead has 4 {{tip|ability|basic abilities}} that each incur a {{sti|cd|{{tt|{{fd|1.5}}-second global cooldown|Affected by ability haste}}}} when cast. Each ability grants a ''Stance'' that empowers his basic attacks, and switching ''Stances'' will replace the empowered attacks of the previous ''Stance''.
params.description2:
Periodically, after '''Udyr''' enters a ''Stance'', he can cast it again at no cost after {{fd|0.25}} seconds and within the following 5 seconds to ''Awaken'' it, empowering the ''Stance'' with an additional effect and placing the effect on cooldown.
If '''Udyr''' does not consume the ''Awaken'' cast within the duration and has not switched ''Stances'', his current ''Stance's'' respective ability incurs a {{fd|0.25}}-second cooldown. ''Awakened Spirit'' is placed on full cooldown at the start of the game.
params.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Monk Training:}} After casting an ability, '''Udyr''' empowers his next two {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} within 4 seconds to gain {{sti|{{as|30% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and refund 5% of ''Awakened Spirit's'' '''total''' cooldown, though not if the remaining cooldown is less than 1 second.
params.customlabel: {{tt|Cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste, but affected by ultimate haste}}
params.notes: * ''Awakened Spirit's'' cooldown is affected by {{sti|ah|icononly=true}} {{as|ultimate haste|ah}}. * ''Awakened'' ability casts are special cased to trigger {{iis|Experimental Hexplate}} {{nie|Overdrive}}, {{iis|Zeke's Convergence}} {{nie|Frostfire Tempest}}, and {{bi|Cloud Dragon Soul|possessive=true}} increased movement speed. * The ''Awakened'' casts of ''{{ai|Wilding Claw|Udyr}}'' and ''{{ai|Wingborne Storm|Udyr}}'' are special cased to trigger {{iis|Malignance}} {{nie|Hatefog}} from their damage. * {{ri|Axiom Arcanist}} will affect the ''Awakened'' cast of all abilities, but does not refund the cooldown of ''Awakened Spirit''. ** Only ''{{ais|Wilding Claw|Udyr}}'' lightning damage is amplified. The on-hit damage is not increased.{{bug|2}} * {{iis|Axiom Arc}} {{nie|Flux}} does not count neither ''Awakened Spirit'' nor ''{{ai|Wingborne Storm|Udyr}}'' as ultimate abilities. * ''Awakened Spirit's'' cooldown is tracked on his [[health bar]] by an {{tip|Fury|Awakening}} resource, visible to all teams. This secondary resource bar is non-descript and represents the effect's percentage charge. ** The bar has a '''white''' color when ''Awakened Spirit'' is under 80% charge, a '''yellow''' color when at 80% charge or above, and a '''red''' color when an ''Awaken'' cast is available. * Switching ''Stances'' will not cause any additional effects granted by the previous one to end prematurely. * The global cooldown will not incur on abilities that are currently on a greater cooldown. * The empowered attacks will not get consumed if they are parried. * ''Awakened Spirit's'' cast also activates ''Monk Training'' and empowers the next 2 attacks by the stances unawakened effects as well, overriding unused unawakened stance attacks.
params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate - Awakened Spirit:}} {{ci|Udyr}} has no ultimate ability and instead he has 4 basic abilities that each incur a {{sti|cd|brief}} global cooldown. Each {{tip|ability}} grants a ''Stance'' that empowers his next two {{tip|basic attacks}}.
params.blurb2: Periodically, after '''Udyr''' enters a ''Stance'', he can cast it again to ''Awaken'' it: empowering the ''Stance'' with an additional effect.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|Innate - Monk Training:}} After casting any of his abilities, ''Udyr's'' next two basic attacks gain {{sti|as|{{as|attack speed}}}} and reduce {{sti|cd|''Awakened Spirit's''}} cooldown.

params.notes:
* The storm that '''Udyr''' surrounds himself with is independent from the unleashed storm.
** He can still cast ''Wingborne Storm'' to surround himself with a storm while an unleashed storm from an ''Awakened'' cast is active.
** Using the ''Awakened'' cast ends the storm around '''Udyr''' if it is active and summons a separate storm that is able to move on its own.
* The slow debuff has a duration equal to the storm's remaining duration and is removed immediately when the unit leaves the storm's area of effect.
** Units receive the debuff whenever they are in the storm, even after having it removed from leaving the area.
* If the target '''Udyr''' has most recently attacked is invalid and there are no nearby enemies then the storm will follow him instead.
** The storm can follow '''Udyr''' regardless of how far away he is from it.
* The storm will remain active even if '''Udyr''' dies. Any commands it was issued to follow a target will not be interrupted.
* The storm will follow its target even if they are not {{tip|sight|visible}}, but only for up to 1 second. 
** If it does not gain vision of its target within that time, it changes its target.
* The storm is obstructed by terrain. If it encounters terrain, then it will automatically navigate its path towards the target.
* The empowered attacks will not trigger nor be consumed if they hit a structure or ward or are parried.
